text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Fine. ...That was
superb.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm frustrated, but I must admit that
you're a
skilled runner.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's unfortunate that I won't have an
opportunity
to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Are you perhaps telling me you're going
to miss
me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'm losing my roommate soon. Do I
really seem
so cold that I can't be
allowed the sentiment?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meant! If anything,
I'm the
cold one...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Instead of being sad with you, I'm
happy—happy
to have become one of
your memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Knowing I'll live on inside of your heart
makes me
so happy... Do you think that's
cold?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... You've always been like that.
But I'm not
the only who will remember
you.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaah!
Go, Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A and B
text_block_list.text: Fiiiiine Motiooon! Sniffle... Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You hear them, don't you? Your memory
will live
on in all of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And it's not born from
sentimentality—it's
because you're
strong.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I love you, my dear Empress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, and we're done here. Hurry up
and do
what needs to be done!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, okay. Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
You're right.
choice_data_list: We still have time, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you... I can run to the
very
ends of the Earth!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the best memories we can
until the
day we have to part!
